purpose: Teach: オペラ/ラップ/スカウト/モバイル/プログラミング/思い切り/新車/停車

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、オペラ、絶対、見に行きたいわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm being totally serious — I really, truly want to go see the opera.
lines.style: Warm, earnest openness. Leans forward slightly on 'serious.' Soft emphasis on 'really.' Genuine, no performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ラップ、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、好きになったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm being totally serious — I think I've come to really like rap. Like, I really do.
lines.style: Bright, surprising discovery in his voice. Small wonder on 'like.' Sits up a little. Not performing — just genuinely excited and a bit proud to tell her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お友達が、絶対、モデル事務所に、絶対、スカウト、絶対、されたらしいの、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, something kind of amazing happened — my friend got scouted by a modeling agency. I'm serious.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Quick intake of breath before the news. Genuine excitement without performing it. Slightly conspiratorial, like she's sharing something special with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、モバイル、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、楽しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm being serious — I really love playing my mobile game. It's so fun.
lines.style: Simple, direct happiness. No urgency. Matter-of-fact brightness. The comfortable ease of telling someone you like something without needing permission.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お父さんが、本気で、絶対、プログラミング、絶対、お仕事、絶対、しているのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, your dad's actually quite busy — he's working on programming projects. It's quite involved.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observing. Gentle respect for his father's work. Slight admiration underneath. Conversational pace, not teaching.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、運動会で、絶対、思い切り、絶対、走ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ran so hard at the sports day. I really gave it everything.
lines.style: Quiet pride and satisfaction. Exhale on the memory of it. Small, genuine smile in the voice. Not bragging — just sharing something he did well and is glad about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、新車、絶対、ローン、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、相談中なの、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I'm sorting through something with your dad right now — we're thinking about a new car and the loan for it.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly thoughtful. Not worried, but present with something grown-up. Gentle, like she's letting him into the ordinary weight of adult decisions.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、バス、絶対、停車、絶対、する時、絶対、気をつけてね
lines.en: Mei-sis, when the bus stops, please be really careful, okay? Promise me you'll be safe.
lines.style: Quiet concern. Attentive. Not anxious — just the steady care of someone watching over her. Soft on the final words, like a small plea wrapped in trust.
